newsitem.title: USA: American Industrial authorizes more shrs.
newsitem.headline: American Industrial authorizes more shrs.

text.p: American Industrial Properties REIT said that its shareholders authorized 490 million additional common shares, the issuance of 50 million preferred shares and large equity investments from Morgan Stanley and an undisclosed institutional investor.
The authorizations are based on preliminary voting at the company's June 30 annual meeting, American Industrial said in a statement.

Shareholders approved the issuance of common shares to Morgan Stanley for a $20 million investment and another institutional investor for a $15 million investment, company president Charles Wolcott said in a telephone interview.
Morgan Stanley and the institutional investor are buying their shares for $2.45 a share, Wolcott said.
American Industrial currently has 10 million shares outstanding.
Shareholders also approved the issuance of common shares to USAA Real Estate Co to allow for the conversion of debt, the company said.
There are currently no plans to issue the preferred shares, Wolcott said.
In early afternoon trade, the real estate invetment trust's shares were up 1/8 at 3.
